from harvests import ROWS
from intake import parse_harvests

LINES = ["%s,%s" % (k, v) for k, v in ROWS]


def test_all_lines():
    assert len(parse_harvests("\n".join(LINES))) == len(ROWS)


def test_trailing_newline():
    assert len(parse_harvests("\n".join(LINES) + "\n")) == len(ROWS)
